citation_as_printed: FakeReasoning: Towards Generalizable Forgery Detection and Reasoning
current_verified_title: Toward Generalizable Forgery Detection and Reasoning (FakeReasoning)
bibliography_identity: Same work; arXiv:2503.21210 v4, published as IEEE Transactions on Image Processing 35 (2026), pp. 3395–3410, DOI 10.1109/TIP.2026.3673967.
relation: AI-generated image detection and structured reasoning/explanation; a close image-forensics model and benchmark reference.
original_evaluation: Original v4 §§V-C, V-H3: text overlap/semantic similarity against GPT-4o-generated explanations; human experts rated reasoning rationality on 100 examples per evaluation set, restricted to cases where both GT and predicted label are fake, on a five-point scale. Dataset annotation QA separately used 10 forensic researchers and a 2,000-image blind spot check with 94.87% agreement.
validity_limits: Model-output human evaluation reports rationality, not explicit claim-level truth/region correctness; reviewer count and inter-rater reliability are not reported in inspected section. Restriction to correct fake predictions excludes real images and false predictions. Dataset annotation agreement is not model-explanation agreement. Text similarity is not causal faithfulness.
screen_classification: Strong task/measurement neighbor; human rationality evidence is useful but weaker than direct fact/grounding scoring.
source_sections: arXiv v4 §§V-C, V-H3, III-B2, VI; official publication DOI

current_verified_title: VLForgery Face Triad: Detection, Localization and Attribution via Multimodal Large Language Models
bibliography_identity: NeurIPS 2025 Main Conference; official DOI 10.52202/085713-5442; arXiv:2503.06142.
relation: Direct face-forgery MLLM that predicts, localizes, and attributes diffusion-generated face forgeries; attribution here includes generator/source identification.
original_evaluation: arXiv官方全文§§3.2、4.2、4.4核读：VLForgery提供Detection/Localization/Attribution结构化描述，目标结果/篡改类型/区域/生成方法标签参与描述构造和训练。表2–6主要报告分类/归因准确率与区域定位；§4.2.2另从partial-synthesis测试集抽取1000例，由人工查看PSCC-Net基线mask，若mask露出任意部分伪造区即记正确。此人工标注针对基线定位mask，不是对VLForgery文字解释进行评分。
validity_limits: 没有自然语言理由事实正确率、claim-level图像支持、解释独立盲评/评审一致性、因果干预faithfulness或用户适当依赖结果。作者使用“credible/high-confidence”描述训练目标，但训练说明中的ground-truth类别/区域/方法及生成偏差提示并不能替代独立验证。强任务近邻，非解释可靠性直接实证。
screen_classification: 强任务近邻；全文评测构念已核，非直接解释可靠性证据。

citation_as_printed: TruthLens: Visual Grounding for Universal DeepFake Reasoning
current_verified_title: FORGE: Forensic Reasoning with Grounded Evidence
bibliography_identity: Same arXiv ID 2503.15867; current v4 dated 2026-09-16 has retitled the work and states acceptance at Findings of EMNLP 2026. Do not count TruthLens and FORGE as separate papers.
relation: Directly evaluates image-based deepfake reasoning explanation faithfulness and unsupported region/attribute claims; one of the closest EFR-cited evaluation studies.
original_evaluation: Three blinded, independent graduate-student annotators rated 300 stratified image-explanation pairs from DD-VQA and DVF on faithfulness, specificity, and forensic helpfulness. Krippendorff ordinal alpha = .68–.74. GPT-4o rubric judge calibrated to annotators (Pearson r .76–.83; Spearman rho .74–.81). Separate claim extraction is compared with GT region/attribute annotations; extraction checked against expert-parsed 200 cases (96.4% precision, 94.1% recall).
validity_limits: Direct factual/region faithfulness and human evaluation, not a causal intervention test of whether model decisions depend on the cited cue. Human set is 300 cases, annotators are graduate students rather than independent practicing forensic analysts, and the benchmark covers DD-VQA face manipulations plus DVF synthetic images. Claim extraction depends on GPT-4o but is benchmarked against expert parsing.
screen_classification: Highest-priority directly relevant explanation-reliability evidence found in EFR references so far.
source_sections: arXiv v4 abstract; §4; Appendix A3.1–A3.3; Appendix A7; EMNLP Findings acceptance stated on source

citation_as_printed: RAIDX: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation and GRPO Reinforcement Learning Framework for Explainable Deepfake Detection
current_verified_title: RAIDX: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation and GRPO Reinforcement Learning Framework for Explainable Deepfake Detection
relation: Direct explainable image deepfake detection with textual rationale and saliency map; close EFR reasoning/grounding comparator.
original_evaluation: §4.3 samples 100 synthetic images from SID-Set. Ten blinded domain experts score output explanations; average score/95% CI reported for SFT vs RAIDX and SIDA vs RAIDX. The inspected section does not spell out rating dimensions, number of ratings per image, randomization details beyond blinding, or inter-rater agreement.
validity_limits: Expert blind rating is direct explanation-quality evidence but the score construct is under-described and agreement is absent. Only fully synthetic imagery is evaluated; the paper states human-aligned explanation-quality metrics are future work. No claim-level factual or causal faithfulness protocol observed.
screen_classification: Strong direct explanation-human-rating candidate with important construct/reporting limitations.

citation_as_printed: Seeing Before Reasoning: A Unified Framework for Generalizable and Explainable Fake Image Detection
current_verified_title: Seeing Before Reasoning: A Unified Framework for Generalizable and Explainable Fake Image Detection
bibliography_identity: arXiv:2509.25502; published at ICLR 2026 per ICLR proceedings author bibliography/source.
relation: Direct fake-image detector and benchmark for explanation correctness, specificity, logic, factual accuracy, and instruction-following.
original_evaluation: ExplainFake-Bench randomly samples 400 fake images each from Chemeleon and GenImage++ (800 total); GPT-4o judges explanation outputs on five dimensions. No human-explanation-rating study was found in the inspected main paper/appendix.
validity_limits: Direct factual-content evaluation but evaluator is a single LLM family with no reported human calibration or inter-rater agreement; correctness rating is tied to output label. Does not use causal interventions/randomization tests.
screen_classification: Strong direct evaluation benchmark; LLM-judge-only evidence, no causal faithfulness test.
source_sections: arXiv §4 ExplainFake-Bench and Appendix E.3; ICLR 2026 proceedings
